reviews.review_msg: Gives useful feedback for assignments, lectures are easy to follow with the occasional group discussions. He's patient and encourages you to ask questions.
Good lectures, helpful outside of class on the projects, whole class was a bunch of fun and I would definitely take it again.

Adrian was awesome! Such a cool and interesting person, and a great professor. For every assignment he would give very detailed feedback (usually paragraphs long) that would really help improve my writing. I learned a lot in this course and I'm glad I took it with him!

Adrian was great and a very kind professor; he was always very understanding and helpful. Quite a number of assignments but they aren't too hard, besides the analysis paper. However, the weekly readings for the course are super long (i'd recommend summarizing them). This was his first semester at SFU and he was my favourite prof this semester.
